description: This file defines a registry and management system for component versions and feature gates within Kubernetes, including version mapping, flag parsing, validation, and metrics collection.

classes.name: ComponentGlobals
classes.description: Stores global version and feature gate information for a component, including version mapping and dependency status.

classes.name: componentGlobalsRegistry
classes.description: Implements the ComponentGlobalsRegistry interface, managing multiple component globals, version configs, and feature gates.

methods.name: AddMetrics
methods.description: Records metrics for all registered components' effective versions.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the registry, clearing all component globals and configurations.

methods.name: EffectiveVersionFor
methods.description: Returns the effective version info for a given component.

methods.name: FeatureGateFor
methods.description: Returns the feature gate for a given component.

methods.name: unsafeRegister
methods.description: Registers a component with its effective version and feature gate, used internally.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a component with its effective version and feature gate, with validation.

methods.name: ComponentGlobalsOrRegister
methods.description: Returns existing globals or registers new ones for a component.

methods.name: unsafeKnownFeatures
methods.description: Returns a sorted list of known feature names across all components.

methods.name: unsafeVersionFlagOptions
methods.description: Generates version range options for command-line flags.

methods.name: getFullVersionConfig
methods.description: Expands version configs with version mappings to produce full component version mappings.

methods.name: toVersionMap
methods.description: Parses version configuration strings into a map of component to version.

methods.name: SetFallback
methods.description: Sets default version configurations if not already set, with a warning.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Applies version configurations and feature gate settings based on parsed flags.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates all component versions and feature gates for correctness.

methods.name: enabledAlphaFeatures
methods.description: Returns a list of enabled alpha features in a component.

methods.name: SetVersionMapping
methods.description: Sets a version mapping from one component to another, updating effective versions accordingly.
